A Note from the Founder
“It was what kept me going.”

During a very difficult time in my family, I kept writing Ram in a simple notebook. Every single day. It was what kept me going.

But a plain notebook has its limits. I never knew how far I'd come. Some days the writing became mechanical, just filling lines. And there was no space to stop and feel what the name was doing for me.

I wanted more people to discover this practice, and to stay with it. So I created Smaran.

108 pages, 108 names on each, so you can watch your journey grow. And along the way, pause pages: a gratitude mandala, a letter to Ram, Hanuman's teachings and lines from the Gita. Small moments that turn writing into remembering.

I hope it holds you the way it held me. One name at a time.

With love, Minakshi.

Questions you may have
What is likhit jap?

Likhit jap is the practice of writing a divine name again and again, with attention and devotion. It is a quiet form of naam jap, done with a pen instead of a mala.

How long does it take to complete Smaran?

Less than 5 mins a page. There is no rush. Write at your own pace.

Which pen works best?

Many saints & experienced practitioners suggest a red pen for writing Ram Naam, so we recommend red if you have one. But any pen you have is perfect. Ram sees the bhav, not the ink.

Can children use it?

Yes. Some families do write in it with their children.

What do I do when I finish?

Keep it in your home mandir, offer it at a temple that accepts naam books, or send it to us for samarpan at a temple in Mumbai.

How do I order?

Fill in the order form below, or message us on WhatsApp or Instagram (@thesacrednook).

How long does delivery take?

Dispatch in 2 days, delivery across India in 5 to 6 days.

Do you take bulk orders?

Yes. For 10 or more copies, message us on WhatsApp for special prices.

Privacy Policy

At The Sacred Nook, home of Smaran, your trust matters to us as much as your practice. This policy explains what we collect, why, and how we keep it safe. By using this website or ordering Smaran, you agree to this policy.

1. What we collect

  • Your details: name, phone number, email and delivery address, when you order Smaran, message us, join the Smaran Sangha or fill in a form on our Instagram or Facebook ads.
  • Payment details: payments are made through UPI or a secure payment link. We never see or store your card or bank details.
  • Website data: basic information such as your browser and the pages you visit, to help the site work well.

2. How we use it

  • To confirm, pack and deliver your Smaran
  • To send order and shipping updates on WhatsApp or email
  • To answer your questions and support you
  • To share news about Smaran and new Sacred Nook journals, only if you've agreed to hear from us

3. Who we share it with

We never sell or trade your details. We share them only with:

  • Our courier partner, to deliver your order
  • Our payment provider, to process your payment
  • Authorities, if the law requires it

4. Keeping it safe

Your details are kept private and used only by The Sacred Nook. You can turn off cookies anytime in your browser settings.

5. Children

We don't knowingly collect details from children under 13. If you think a child has shared their details with us, write to us and we'll remove them.

6. Your choices

To update or delete your details, or to stop receiving messages from us, email thesacrednook.co@gmail.com.

7. Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The latest version will always be on this page.
